summary: Iteration 37 - Tested P0 Fix: Booking Payment Status Flow. All 9 backend tests passed. P0 fix verified: Bookings with kreditkarte/paypal now correctly return payment_status='pending_payment'. Bookings with rechnung (for authorized schausteller with kauf_auf_rechnung=True) correctly return payment_status='ausstehend'. p0_fix_verification.fix_description: Bookings were being confirmed (DB entry + email) BEFORE Stripe payment was completed. Now bookings are created with 'pending_payment' status for credit card/paypal. Only after successful payment (via webhook/polling), booking is activated to 'ausstehend' and confirmation email sent.
